title: Marking the Boat for a Lost Sword

source.quote: A man of Chu was crossing a river. His sword fell from the boat into the water, and he hastily carved a mark on the boat's side, saying: 'This is where my sword fell.' When the boat stopped, he went into the water at the place he had marked. But the boat had moved on, while the sword had not. To seek a sword like this — is it not confusing?

moral: The world keeps moving; a mark must be made on something that does not.
